method.mine: 8 parallel read-only scouts, one per surface slice
method.verify: 2 independent adversarial skeptics per high-value finding (lens 1 = does it exist and is it callable; lens 2 = is it genuinely unused and is the value honest), each instructed to refute and to default to refuted when unsure
method.adjudication: existence-refutation kills a finding; value-refutation downgrades it

surviving_high.surface: libamdhip64.so exports: `hipGraphGetNodes@@hip_4.4`, `hipGraphNodeGetType@@hip_4.5`, `hipGraphKernelNodeGetParams@@hip_4.4`; decls hip_runtime_api.h:8616,8678,8869. Interposer map crates/redline-hipgraph/redline_hipgraph.map does NOT export them; lib.rs only dlsyms them for private reconcile_captured_native_nodes.
surviving_high.evidence: nm: `0000000000560650 T hipGraphGetNodes@@hip_4.4` / `0000000000566b90 T hipGraphNodeGetType@@hip_4.5` / `0000000000562410 T hipGraphKernelNodeGetParams@@hip_4.4`. map globals stop at Create/AddKernel/Instantiate/Launch/… — no GetNodes. decode_ab.c:77-83: `HCHECK(hipGraphGetNodes(graph, NULL, &nnodes));` … `hipGraphNodeGetType(nodes[i], &t)`. lib.rs:2059 uses `real_symbol(...b"hipGraphGetNodes\0")` only internally.
surviving_high.what_it_enables: Enumerate nodes of a captured/built graph, classify node types, and read kernel node params (func/grid/block/kernargs) so apps can locate nodes for hipGraphExecKernelNodeSetParams updates.
surviving_high.relevance_to_redline: Open problem #5: after hipStreamEndCapture the interposer returns a Redline hipGraph_t. Unmodified apps (and Redline’s own decode_ab/decode_chain_ab examples) immediately call GetNodes/GetType/KernelNodeGetParams; without interposing these, apps either see native-only handles or fail to find Redline nodes, blocking the common capture→find-node→ExecKernelNodeSetParams→Launch loop. Exporting them over Redline GraphState is the single highest-leverage completeness fix.

unverified_findings.what_it_enables: Tune per-agent async scratch reclaim threshold: permanent per-queue scratch vs use-once, and reclaim by lowering threshold (may block until in-flight scratch dispatches complete).
Force early init of clock-sync tables and blit kernel objects for a GPU agent so first real dispatch/copy does not pay lazy setup.
CUDA-style virtual memory: reserve VA, back with pool handles, map/unmap subranges, set per-agent access, export/import shareable/fabric handles. Stable VAs independent of physical backing.
Register non-blocking completion callbacks on signals; schedule work on ROCr's event thread without a dedicated app waiter thread.
Classify any pointer ROCr knows about: placement, owning agent, access set, VMEM vs pool vs IPC, alloc flags — without guessing from the allocator API used.
Map a signal handle to a raw pollable value pointer; recover the KFD event id backing interrupt signals.
Create queues that may run cooperative kernels using global wave sync (GWS).
Eager preload of agent clock-sync and blit kernels before first dispatch — removes first-touch latency from warm paths.
Map HSA completion signals to KFD event IDs for correlation with drm/debugfs/KFD traces; optional direct cast of signal handle to amd_signal_t for mailbox/timestamps without extra API.

unverified_findings.what_it_enables: Per-dispatch metadata queue programming: CP-driven L2 tile prefetch before kernel, green-context CU slicing without hsa_amd_queue_cu_set_mask, occupancy cap via granularity limiter.
Resolve device VA→host-accessible alias for loaded segments; enumerate loaded code objects/segments for a process — essential for offline PC→symbol and ATT correlation without parsing ELF alone.
Intercept AQL packet streams (rewrite/observe before CP); global notifier on every queue create — hipGraph interposer could see foreign queues without LD_PRELOAD of hsa_queue_create alone.
Read CP-updated scratch SRDs, alt-scratch path, per-XCC last-use indices, write/read_dispatch_id, queue_inactive_signal without extra syscalls.
Callback-level trace of scratch grow/reclaim concurrent with dispatches (dispatch_id, size, num_slots, USE_ONCE/ALT flags).
Anonymous event fd for VMFAULT, page-fault, migrate, and especially queue eviction/restore with trigger codes — same-process without root; all-process needs superuser.
Userspace PM4 ring with direct doorbell write — bypass AQL packet format and ROCr packet processors. SDMA queue types also available.
Live change of ring base/size, quantum percentage, and 16-level priority without destroy/recreate.
Per-queue CU bitmask at KFD level (same mechanism ROCr wraps as hsa_amd_queue_cu_set_mask).
DRM userqueue create path with caller-supplied MQD blob (shadow/CSA/EOP VAs) — parallel to KFD queues, not a full HQD dword programming interface for COMPUTE_PGM_*.
If callable, returns CSA pointer and header for a thunk-level queue id — direct path to post-preempt wave state.
Async buffer of per-dispatch GPU start/end ns plus dispatch_info (agent, queue, kernel_id, dispatch_id). Tool path: rocprofv3 --kernel-trace.
Direct ROCr PC-sampling extension without loading rocprofiler-sdk; session create/start/stop/flush with client data-ready callback.
Streaming performance monitor: high-rate counter time series (sclk-interval) with per-sample timestamps and optional dispatch_id, via either baked PM4 (aqlprofile) or SDK dispatch SPM service.
Instruction-level Advanced Thread Trace (ATT) with SE shader data decoded via librocprof-trace-decoder; dispatch callback chooses which launches to trace.
Non-serializing, on-demand agent-wide PMC reads while the GPU runs—no per-kernel barrier pairs.
Timeline of KFD queue evict/restore (CWSR/SVM/TTM/suspend)—not doorbell writes.
Read-only inventory of which counters, SPM configs, and PC-sampling methods the installed driver/agent actually expose before wiring redline-observe.
